statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit of four public templates plus a 404 recovery route. No local source was supplied.

page.notes: Public German weather/content site. A Sourcepoint-style consent/pay wall blocks the first-load experience. The repository web-uplift.json was not applied because it scopes the local playground, not this external target.

paths.description: Homepage and first-load weather discovery; covers global chrome, consent, preferences, mobile layout, security and performance.
City forecast/detail archetype; represents local forecast pages and weather lookup output.
Interactive radar archetype; represents map-heavy app surfaces and repeated-interaction memory testing.
Editorial advice/article archetype; represents content templates and structured metadata.
Invalid route used to test HTTP/error recovery state.

Authenticated membership, paid checkout/cancellation, account management, and destructive actions were not entered because they require credentials or payment; one representative route per public template was selected rather than every city/article URL.

findings.summary: The site does not follow the user’s dark colour preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is visually identical to the light capture, and the DOM reports color-scheme: normal with white surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface/text tokens using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: A non-essential image-border animation continues under reduced motion.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe confirms the media query matches, while animateImageBorder remains running with a 5000 ms duration.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable or simplify decorative animation inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Route and state changes have no declarative transition support.
findings.evidence: Representative rendered DOM probes found no view-transition usage across homepage, forecast, radar, and article templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance route and major state changes with same- or cross-document View Transitions, retaining an instant fallback.

findings.summary: Interactive weather surfaces expose no declarative gesture/scroll-snap treatment.
findings.evidence: The radar template probe found neither scroll-driven nor view-transition support, while the page is an interactive map surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Use platform scrolling, overscroll-behavior and scroll-snap where gesture navigation is present; avoid custom pointer loops.

findings.summary: Page chrome does not expose scroll-state-aware behaviour.
findings.evidence: Across long homepage and article templates, probes found no declarative scroll timeline/state signal; screenshots show a fixed desktop-style navigation frame.
findings.suggestedFix: Use progressive scroll-state/container-query treatment for shrinking or position-aware chrome where it improves orientation.

findings.summary: Menus and overlays do not use modern anchored primitives.
findings.evidence: DOM probes found no popover or dialog primitives on the representative templates; the CMP is a manually fixed iframe overlay.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover plus CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks for transient menus/tooltips.

findings.summary: Navigation does not provide directional or state-change attention cues.
findings.evidence: No view-transition or scroll-marker/highlight signal was found on representative routes, while the site exposes dense multi-level navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add current-location cues and progressive directional transitions/highlights for route and carousel changes.

findings.summary: A full-screen consent/paywall interruption obscures all primary content on first load.
findings.evidence: Desktop, mobile, dark, and high-contrast captures all show a fixed full-viewport CMP before any interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the blocking wall with a compact, equally prominent consent choice that leaves essential weather content available and is easy to dismiss.

findings.summary: The blocking consent UI is an ad-hoc fixed iframe rather than a semantic dialog.
findings.evidence: DOM evidence shows #sp_message_container fixed at z-index 2147483647 with an iframe and role=dialog wrapper, but no dialog or popover element.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a real dialog for the modal flow, with labelled semantics, focus management, Escape/cancel handling, and a non-modal compact alternative where possible.

findings.summary: Dense navigation and promotional chrome compete with weather content.
findings.evidence: The mobile capture renders the full 1160 px desktop frame, multiple navigation rows, promotional modules and the CMP at a tiny scale.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise weather content, collapse secondary navigation on narrow screens, and defer below-fold promotional modules.

findings.summary: The site forces a 1160 px desktop viewport on phones instead of adapting to the device width.
findings.evidence: The viewport meta is width=1160. A 360x800 capture reports layout width 1160 and visual scale 0.31, making the page and consent controls tiny.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width, initial-scale=1 and responsive intrinsic layout rather than a fixed virtual desktop viewport.

findings.summary: Container-level responsiveness is inconsistent across templates.
findings.evidence: Only the Berlin probe found a container-query signal; radar and article probes found none, and all retain the fixed 1160 px viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt container-type and size-aware component rules for reused forecast, navigation, card, and article modules.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly styled on primary navigation and search controls.
findings.evidence: The focus probe programmatically focused 30 visible controls; sampled links and inputs consistently reported outline-style none and no focus box shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Add high-contrast :focus-visible styles and keep targets at least about 44 CSS px for touch.

findings.summary: The primary weather lookup journey is gated before users can act.
findings.evidence: Every first-load screenshot shows only two forward choices: accept advertising/tracking or pay €1.99/month; no reject/dismiss choice exposes the weather task.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow essential forecast lookup before optional consent, and present a clear, non-coercive reject/manage choice beside accept.

findings.summary: Loading performance misses the good LCP range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 5.2 s, LCP 6.4 s and Speed Index 7.7 s (performance 0.61); the independent trace measured LCP 4.74 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP element, reduce render-blocking resources, and defer non-essential CMP/promotional work.

findings.summary: The critical path contains many parser-blocking styles and large early resources.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 141 requests/1.83 MB and at least eight VeryHigh-priority parser-inserted stylesheets; scripts include 211 KB and 189 KB transfers.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline critical CSS, defer non-critical styles, set correct script defer/module attributes, compress the 85 KB forecast JSON and trim dependency chains.

findings.summary: Substantial unused JavaScript and CSS ship on first load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 348 KiB unused JS and 28 KiB unused CSS, including 79% waste in m-global.js and 67% in the CMP bundle.
findings.suggestedFix: Split bundles by template and consent state; load promotional and CMP code only when needed.

findings.summary: Images and form controls lack accessible alternatives and labels.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed image-alt; the image audit found 13 missing alts. DOM probes show visible search inputs/selects without labels or aria-labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Add meaningful alt text or empty alt for decoration, and associate every visible field with a label and accessible submit name.

findings.summary: Small advertising text fails minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured “Hier werben” at 3.54:1 (#888 on white) at 10 px, below the 4.5:1 requirement.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the text or increase its size/weight so it meets WCAG contrast.

findings.summary: Landmark/language consistency and visible focus are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Homepage and Berlin rendered probes have no html lang value; the homepage heading list starts at H2 and the focus probe found no visible outline on sampled controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang=de on every template, provide a logical H1/landmark hierarchy, and restore visible focus indicators.

findings.summary: Narrow-screen reflow and target sizing are inadequate.
findings.evidence: The mobile condition is rendered at 31% scale because of width=1160; primary search controls are 36 px high, below a comfortable touch target.
findings.suggestedFix: Use device-width responsive reflow and enlarge interactive targets without disabling user zoom.

findings.summary: Image delivery and document assets have avoidable hygiene issues.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 2 images without dimensions, 25 below-fold images not lazy-loaded, 14 without srcset, and 9 legacy-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve image dimensions, lazy-load below-fold media, and provide responsive modern-format sources.

findings.summary: Some navigation is not crawlable and the mobile signal is misleading.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed crawlable anchors for an install action without href; the viewport advertises width=1160 rather than device width.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href destinations for navigation/actions and a device-width viewport.

findings.summary: The sitemap endpoint was unavailable to the audit client.
findings.evidence: A direct GET to /sitemap.xml returned HTTP 403, while representative pages otherwise returned 200 with canonical URLs.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a standards-compliant sitemap to ordinary crawler user agents and reference it from robots.txt; verify no edge rule blocks it.

findings.summary: Article structured metadata is incomplete.
findings.evidence: The article has title/description/canonical but no JSON-LD block; the homepage only supplies Organization JSON-LD.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Article/NewsArticle JSON-LD and complete Open Graph/Twitter metadata matching visible article content.

findings.summary: Core browser security headers are missing.
findings.evidence: The header primitive found no CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, or Referrer-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS, nosniff, a restrictive CSP including frame-ancestors, and an explicit privacy-preserving Referrer-Policy.

findings.summary: The first-load privacy footprint is large and consent is coercive.
findings.evidence: The tracker probe saw 13 non-main origins. HAR attributes 76 requests and 1.33 MB to non-main origins, while the CMP asks users to accept 215 partners or pay.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors and pre-consent requests, gate optional analytics until opt-in, and offer a reject choice equal to accept.

findings.summary: The membership sign-in surface exposes no evidence of phishing-resistant authentication.
findings.evidence: The page advertises member login, but rendered/source probes found no WebAuthn or passkey affordance; permissions are limited to geolocation self.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkeys/WebAuthn in account flows and request geolocation only after an explicit weather-location action.

findings.summary: The app-like weather experience lacks a discoverable web app manifest.
findings.evidence: The platform probe finds service worker support but no link rel=manifest on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a manifest and a tested offline forecast/error shell for app-like radar and saved-location journeys.

findings.summary: Core templates omit language metadata and rely on physical CSS directions.
findings.evidence: Homepage and Berlin have empty html lang/dir; the probe counted zero logical-property rules and 15 sampled physical left/right rules. The article alone sets lang=de.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang=de consistently, derive dir where needed, and migrate layout spacing/positioning to logical properties.

findings.summary: The consent wall presents accept-tracking versus paid access without an equivalent reject choice.
findings.evidence: The first-load modal says consent covers 215 partners and offers “Akzeptieren & Weiter” or €1.99/month; only buried settings can alter consent.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide equally prominent accept, reject, and manage choices; keep essential content available and avoid pay-or-consent coercion.

findings.summary: Search input assistance is incomplete.
findings.evidence: The location search field has autocomplete=off and no associated label; other visible text/select controls also lack autocomplete and labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Add visible labels and appropriate autocomplete tokens; do not disable browser autocomplete without a demonstrated need.

findings.summary: Image assets are not consistently optimised for viewport and format.
findings.evidence: Image evidence found 14 missing srcsets, 9 legacy formats and 25 below-fold images loaded eagerly.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP responsive sources and lazy-load below-fold imagery while preserving LCP priority.

findings.summary: First load performs disproportionate optional work.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 141 requests, including 35 scripts and 72 images; Lighthouse found hundreds of KiB of unused code before the user can access content.
findings.suggestedFix: Deprioritise or remove promotional/background fetches and conditionally load route-specific code.

findings.summary: Third-party and consent resources dominate transferred bytes.
findings.evidence: HAR attributes 1.33 MB of 1.83 MB and 76 of 141 requests to non-main origins; the CMP alone adds a 95 KB script and delayed document.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget, self-host essential assets, and defer vendors and media until user intent.

taskList.title: Replace the blocking pay-or-consent wall with equal accept/reject/manage choices and preserve essential weather access
Replace width=1160 with device-width responsive reflow and restore accessible target/focus sizing
Cut LCP and first-load cost by trimming/defering critical CSS, unused bundles, third parties and eager media
Fix labels, alt text, language, landmarks, focus and contrast across templates
Deploy baseline security headers and reduce the pre-consent third-party footprint
Improve crawl/index metadata, sitemap access, and article JSON-LD
Add a manifest/offline recovery for app-like weather journeys
Progressively enhance interaction and navigation with platform transitions, anchors and scroll-state cues
